tool_args.rationale: All five pilot rows have H ≤ 0.48, but the forecast target is H = 20.4. The slow-horizon probe tests whether adaptation reverses the positive short-window response and helps distinguish its amplitude from its time constant.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, the slow term mainly identifies the ratio of adaptation amplitude to time constant, not the two parameters separately.
Finer short-window sampling would not directly test whether the response reverses near the target horizon.
